label: preparing
what: Innkeeper is organizing a confidential great-hall gathering for day 1 at 18:00, with builder and freight helping. I know the invitation but not the concealed details or purpose. Builder has installed eight lanterns free and discusses grain with innkeeper; secretary knowingly assists with booking and escort arrangements, though her knowledge of the underlying plans is uncertain. A celebration of my forty years of service is plausible, not confirmed.
